WITH rental_films AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.rating, f.film_id
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
),
rating_counts AS (
  SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM rental_films
  GROUP BY rating
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    film_count,
    (SELECT AVG(film_count) FROM rating_counts) AS overall_avg
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT 
  AVG(film_count) AS avg_count,
  AVG(film_count - overall_avg) AS avg_excess
FROM stats
WHERE film_count > overall_avg
